prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1282; do not mention it.)
text:
I write on behalf of our client regarding a motor vehicle collision that occurred when the other driver sideswiped our client's vehicle while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already contacted our client, please let us know so that we may address it.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision, including photographs, dashcam or telematics data, recorded statements, claim file materials, vehicle inspection reports, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained.
